Former Dortmund Teammates Clash in World Cup Final Showdown
Historical Context of Dortmund Rivalries
On 2026-07-09, the World Cup witnessed a historic clash between Erling Haaland and Jude Bellingham, former Borussia Dortmund teammates who forged a close friendship during their tenure at the German club. Their rivalry, now intensified by the global stage, echoes the intense competition that has defined Dortmund’s storied football history. According to Bundesliga official records, the duo’s partnership at Dortmund from 2020 to 2023 was marked by 78 combined league appearances, with Haaland scoring 27 goals and Bellingham contributing 14 assists.
